scope: Six Classic v11 Tools icons, with paired theme artwork and preserved gold, cyan and pink accents. Text remains neutral themed ink. Original project vectors, not extracted Windows assets.

checks.native: Two actual native Wgpu framebuffer captures, 1360x900 logical points at 2x display density; light and dark, selected Pencil. Visually reviewed.
checks.regression: Before correction the existing color assertion failed for zoom-in. Both themes now preserve hue families at 24/48/96/128 pixels; theme alpha geometry matches and texture identities remain independent.

limitations: No claim of exact native Windows pixel parity, new tool capabilities, OS accessibility qualification or performance improvement.
Captures are application framebuffers and exclude the macOS title and menu bars.
T15 and the overall roadmap remain partial.
